articles.title: The $82,000 battle: bitcoin tests key resistance zone to form next major breakout
articles.snippet: BTC is fighting a technical battle as it trades just below two closely watched long-term trend indicators: the 200-day Simple Moving Average and the 200-day Exponential Moving Average.

articles.title: JPMorgan files to launch new tokenized fund as Wall Street tokenization race heats up
articles.snippet: The global banking giant is expanding its tokenized money market lineup, following BlackRock's similar move just a few days ago.

articles.title: 'Lord of the Rings' Director Peter Jackson Says AI Is 'Just a Special Effect'
articles.snippet: Peter Jackson says Hollywood’s fears around AI could hurt recognition for performance-capture acting, as debates about how the technology will reshape the movie industry grow.

articles.title: Half of AI Health Advice Is Wrong—And Seems Just Right
articles.snippet: A peer-reviewed audit in BMJ Open found that nearly 50% of health responses from five major AI chatbots were problematic, with fabricated sources and confident delivery.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Circle Stock Soars After Q1 Beat, $222M Arc Raise
articles.snippet: Circle just beat earnings and raised fresh capital for its new Arc blockchain, while Michael Saylor explained how and why he'd sell Bitcoin.
